reviews.title: Years of daily use, but the ads have finally made me leave!
reviews.text:
I’ve used SofaScore every day for several years. It has been my go to app for football scores, fixtures, line ups and statistics, and I genuinely think the core app is excellent.

Unfortunately, the advertising has become so intrusive that I’m finally deleting it and moving to FotMob.

I completely understand that a free app needs to make money, and I have no issue with reasonable banner advertising. What I can’t accept is constant full-screen and video adverts interrupting me when I simply want to check a score.

The final straw was opening SofaScore and getting a full-screen advert featuring a virtually naked woman covering her private parts. I use this app at work and around other people. I shouldn’t have to worry about what might suddenly appear on my screen when I’m checking a football score.

Looking through the recent reviews, it’s clear I’m far from the only long-term user leaving because of the advertising.

It’s a shame. You’ve taken an app I happily used daily for years and made the advertising intrusive enough that I’d rather move to a competitor.

reviews.title: Ads have ruined the experience
reviews.text:
SofaScore was my go-to sports app for several years and, underneath the recent changes, I still think it’s one of the stronger products in the market.

Unfortunately, the current advertising implementation has made the experience noticeably worse. I completely understand the need to monetise a free app, but the frequency and intrusiveness of the ads now interrupt the core reason people open SofaScore — quickly checking scores, statistics and match information.

This feels particularly risky in such a competitive market, where users have plenty of alternative live-score and statistics apps to choose from. Advertising should support the product rather than become a reason to leave it.

I’d much rather see less disruptive placements, sensible frequency limits, and perhaps a clearly priced ad-free option. SofaScore has a very good underlying product, which is why it’s frustrating to see the user experience being compromised this way.

reviews.text: I pay for this because it’s the only way to use it (the relentless adverts and constant odd market graphics make it utterly pointless otherwise), but even the paid version has become a glitchy mess. You’ll miss WNBA games because Sofascore has them listed on the wrong date. You’ll wonder why Sofascore lists the wrong team as having opened the score in a Stanley Cup final game, and why it takes 30+ minutes to correct the error. You’ll wait hours for confirmation an NBA game has ended because Sofascore tends to just freeze whenever something is in overtime. A scores app has one job to do — update the scores — but this one has become completely sidetracked with creating content, weird Fantasy mini-games, the annoying prediction game, the pointless Sofascore+ “data analyst” features.

reviews.title: Ruined
reviews.text:
I used to value this app for the ability to quickly check scores. Sofascore was great at updating before most alternatives had registered that a goal had occurred. 

Recently the app creators seem to be overstretching. Unrequested notifications about their podcast, pointless functionalities that do very little to enhance the experience, and worst of all, the ads, which are now incessant. 

Despite enjoying Sofascore for many years, I will be switching to an alternative that doesn’t provide me with an inescapable ad when I want to quickly check the scores.

reviews.title: Video ads ruined it
reviews.text: Used this app for years and genuinely liked it, but the decision to force video ads was the final straw. Nothing ruins the user experience faster than having intrusive videos interrupt what should be a simple, straightforward app. It’s disappointing to see a once-great app prioritize ad revenue over the people who actually use it. After years of loyalty, I deleted it the moment the video ads started playing. There are plenty of alternatives that respect their users’ time and attention.

reviews.title: Ads
reviews.text: Were amazing, now there are ads everywhere

reviews.title: Ruined by adverts 💵
reviews.text: Been using the app for many years. With the recent update which throws up an advert after 20secs of being on the app is very annoying and disappointing. It’s hard to click off it without loading up the advert! Will be looking for an alternative after so many years!

reviews.title: Once great app now just full of ads.
reviews.text:
The last Last couple of months the app has been becoming increasingly unreliable on multiple fronts (slow to non existent notifications,multiple notifications for a single event) and now the latest update has really ratcheted up the ad content to an annoying level.

Hopefully this gets fixed in a later update as of now I’ll just shift to Flashscore and use sofa on occasion to check and see if enough people feel the same and the devs dial back on the aggressive advertising.

Update this app now disregards preferences and will just send random notifications with them disabled in the app and within settings so I wouldn’t be surprised if it was also disregarding other privacy settings anyways finally done with this app.

reviews.title: Ads and UI Changes
reviews.text:
Finally had to delete after over 10 years. Ads became too much and this weird partnership with Kalshi is the final straw. Nobody likes random pop up unskippable ads. Moved to FotMob 

Constant UI changes overload the user. There is no need to constantly change font, colors of lineups, layout of the game flow, without adding features. My comments to the developers - keep it simple on UI. The green pitch is annoying to look at. The font on iPhone looks ugly. Either give users the ability to customize or stop changing the UI every 2 weeks. 

App itself is great otherwise.

reviews.title: So many adverts! Unusable
reviews.text:
I’ve been using Sofascore as my primary score checking app since 2018. The most recent updates and introduction of so many adverts has made this completely unusable. 

A score checking app is mainly used to quickly check on matches etc. if I have to wait 1 minute for an advert to run before being able to see these scores it’s completely redundant. 

What was once a great app has continued to decline over the past 2 years

reviews.title: Used to be good now it’s a glitchy mess pushing ads for dodgy chat apps with fake women
reviews.text:
It was one thing pushing ads for gambling in my face and now its cam chat apps? Come on, do better. Deleting this app now as there are far better options out there. 
It is also now extremely glitchy, randomly closes and gets stuck and often doesn’t load. What happened? I used this app as my go to for years.

reviews.title: I wanted to give it 0 stars! ADVERTS FOR GAMBLING APP
reviews.text: I have a interest in many sports, football & F1 being my top 2. I have a few sports app as I have live scores running on my Ultra Watch, IPads, phone and in my car if I am out and about during live coverage. What annoys me more is the Gambling odds only removed if you sign up so they can a) get your personal info to send more gambling opportunities, and b) get you to pay £3.49 PER MONTH JUST TO REMOVE ADDS! BUT DONT WORRY, they send emails & notifications for betting options. Other apps are a) better and b) F R E E!! Don’t waste your money

reviews.title: Whole app collapses at least every month
reviews.text:
This is by far the best scores app. For me it is the only good app with Football and Cricket (with scorecards) plus all the nice analysis and stats. 

But it is getting unusable, at least every month their API feed goes down and there is an issue with their feed (shows no info at all) and I either have to redownload, reinstall or wait up to a week for it to be fixed! 

So frustrating as there is so much potential here.

reviews.title: OUR SERVER IS HAVING ISSUES
reviews.text:
This was my favorite app/website by far to use for all sports. Now, I can only get it to work 1 out of 10 times. I try turning my VPN off, disconnect from WiFi, deleting the app & closing out of the browser. Nothing works. Either there’s the server having issues or there’s “no games today”. Very disappointing because it was the best way to keep up with live sport.

I’d recommend you save your time and find something else that works consistently.

reviews.title: Many Bugs and Glitches
reviews.text: Very buggy app, specifically in the Favorites section. When deleting all finished matches, some will reappear and then be unable to be deleted, cluttering your feed with finished games. The “live activities” feature for iPhone is useless as the games you add to your lock screen constantly freeze and won’t update, forcing you to delete and readd the games. Instead of adding some gimmicky yearly recap like all the other apps do, let’s fix the features you actually have. Would be a great app if not so buggy (and the overpriced subscription to remove ads).
